subject: Monarch POC — Dedicated GPU requirements & technical runbook scheduling
messages:
From: Rita Sharma <rita@monarchanalytics.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Blake <tom.blake@monarchanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Monarch POC — dedicated GPU deep-dive request

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The Monarch engineering team wants to move from demo to a short technical review to lock down the dedicated-GPU topology we need for the POC (pool sizing, autoscaling knobs, tenant isolation). Can we schedule a 60–75 minute session next week with your infra/architecture folks?

Top asks from our side:
- recommended GPU counts for 8–12 concurrent workers (varied seq lengths)
- options for workspace/network isolation (VPC/Pen test scope)
- autoscale latency/throughput tradeoffs and warm/KV cache strategy
- high-level runbook for failover and throttling policies

Proposed windows (PST): Wed 7/29 9:30–11:00, Thu 7/30 10:00–11:15, or Fri 7/31 8:30–10:00.

Can you confirm availability and who from Redwood should join? Also happy to share our traffic profile and a short list of sample prompts if helpful.

Thanks,
Rita
Rita Sharma
Head of ML Engineering, Monarch Analytics
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rita Sharma <rita@monarchanalytics.com>, Tom Blake <tom.blake@monarchanalytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Monarch POC — dedicated GPU deep-dive request

Hi Rita / Tom —

Great to hear Monarch is ready to land the POC requirements. We can take the deep-dive and will bring infra + product. Proposed attendees from Redwood: myself (solutions/po), Karthik (serving/runtime), Marcus (capacity & ops), Hannah (security/compliance).

We can do Wed 7/29 9:30–10:45 PST — I blocked 75 minutes to cover architecture and a short Q&A. If that doesn't work, Thu 10:00–11:15 is our backup.

Agenda (draft):
1) Goals & success criteria (10m)
2) Traffic/profile review (10m)
3) Proposed GPU pool topology + sizing (20m)
4) Autoscale and warm cache strategy (15m)
5) Isolation/networking controls & evidence items (10m)
6) Next steps / action items (10m)

I've attached a short capacity plan and a preliminary runbook draft to give you something concrete to react to before the meeting. Please drop sample prompts/seq distributions in the Drive link if you can — that will help Karthik size the KV cache assumptions.

Attachments: monarch_capacity_plan_v2.pdf, runbook-draft.md

If Wed 7/29 9:30 PST works, I'll send the calendar invite and include a read-ahead link.

Best,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Monarch POC — dedicated GPU deep-dive request

Tessa —

Wed 9:30 PST is fine for me. Couple of quick notes to prepare:
- Marcus: can you confirm whether Monarch's sample traffic (if heavy long-context batches) pushes us toward M40 vs. A100 sizing in the plan?
- We should prepare a short slide on "KV cache priming" — what footprint we expect per active session and how that affects warmup latency.
- Also flag networking: if Monarch wants tenant-level VPC isolation we should confirm CIDR and peering expectations. That's often a procurement blocker.

I'll draft the KV cache slide and a short checklist for isolation evidence (SOC2/penetration test scopes, network flow logs).

Karthik
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rita Sharma <rita@monarchanalytics.com>, Tom Blake <tom.blake@monarchanalytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 07:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Calendar: Monarch POC — Dedicated GPU topology & runbook (75m) — 29 Jul 2026 09:30 PST

Thanks — invite sent for Wed 29 Jul 09:30–10:45 PST: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=monarch-poc-deepdive-20260729

Read-ahead: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cRunbookMonarch (contains the capacity plan, runbook draft, and a small topology diagram).

Quick logistical notes:
- We'll share slides and a short live topology diagram (Marcus will remote in with ops console).
- Please upload any prompt/sequence samples to the Drive folder by EOD tonight so Karthik can finalize sizing numbers.
- Hannah: will outline required compliance evidence and the timeline for providing network logs/SOC artifacts; Marissa will coordinate any procurement questions/next-step paperwork.

Attachments included in thread: monarch_capacity_plan_v2.pdf, monarch_network_topology.png

Looking forward to it.

Tessa
From: Rita Sharma <rita@monarchanalytics.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Blake <tom.blake@monarchanalytics.com>, procurement@monarchanalytics.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Calendar: Monarch POC — Dedicated GPU topology & runbook (75m) — 29 Jul 2026 09:30 PST

Thanks Tessa — confirmed. We've uploaded a short set of sample prompts and a 24-hour traffic trace into the Drive folder. A couple of quick asks before the meeting:

1) Can you confirm whether you can share a short checklist of SOC2 artifacts and sample retention settings you recommend (we have an internal audit next quarter)?
2) Procurement wants to understand lead times for reserved capacity if we choose a committed Dedicated pool after the POC — can Marcus provide ballpark procurement timelines and upgrade windows?

If you can include those two items in the two slides Karthik mentioned, that'll help us a lot. See you shortly.

Best,
Rita
